name: Children's Creativity Museum
note: Zeum (1998, Adele Naude Santos), 221 Fourth, on Moscone South's garden deck. Custom-modelled from the owner's aerials (docs/shots/refs/aerials/ms-childrens-museum-*.webp): a dark truncated cone WIDER AT THE TOP over a glazed drum, a serpentine block banded orange over dark glazing curving from the Creativity Theater round to it, a circular sunken plaza in pink-red paving, and a grand fan staircase out of that plaza. Replaces a spec() stucco box (BUGS.md #140). Height is the cone's top: garden 4 + 13.

name: LeRoy King Carousel
note: The 1906 Looff carousel at 4th and Howard, housed 1998, on TRUE GROUND LEVEL taking a corner out of Moscone. A shallow GLAZED DOME with radial ribs, pale blue-green - not conical, as an earlier note in our docs had it (ms-carousel-closeup.webp) - on a low drum with a painted band, on a circular plinth stepped all round. OSM says height=5, which is the drum; 9 to the dome's crown.

name: South of Market Child Care
note: Yerba Buena Gardens Child Development Center, 790 Folsom: a 116-corner organic plan on garden level, never queued until 2026-09-23. Several offset wings under pale ribbed metal roofs with round skylight drums, board-formed concrete walls along Folsom, and one big straight staircase up through the planted bank. The undulating parapets are APPROXIMATED by stepping segments and the murals are flat colour panels, both on the owner's instruction that this building is not prominent.
